title: 第四章 危
content_zh:
“啧...头好疼...身体好冷.....”
伴随着萧瑟的寒风，再次从混沌中醒来，一种内外交加的头疼让许元整个人都不想睁开眼睛。
他身体上的衣服湿漉漉的，冰冷刺骨的寒风吹拂在湿润的衣服上，不断带走着他身上为数不多的热量。
几乎一瞬之间，许元便意识到了自己这具身体已经失温了。
一点点睁开眼眸，许元昏迷前的记忆如潮水般涌上心头。
穿越、巨佛、以及黑衣女子的那一记闷棍。
大致捋清楚了自己所处境遇，伴随阵阵内外交加的头疼，许元有些艰难挪动眼球，开始打量起周遭的环境。
这里似乎是一处山洞，不大，也就四五米深。
山洞外的天已经亮了，雨依旧在淅沥沥的下着，不过这一次没了佛堂内的篝火，山洞内有些阴冷。
黑衣女子正坐在山洞门口闭目养神，她的剑平放在身侧，剑刃旁还放着一根颇为眼熟木棍。
“.......”许元。
抿了抿有些干燥发白的嘴唇，许元一点一点的挪动身体靠在了身后冰冷的石壁上。
紧紧只是这一简单的动作，便让他这具孱弱的身体开始气喘。
前世还算良好的家境让他有充足的的时间的金钱去体验各种不同的生活，野外探险旅行便是其中之一。
而也正是因为如此，过往的经历让许元知道自己现在病得很严重。
失温、高烧、甚至还有一些脱水。
许元看向洞口面罩薄纱的黑衣女子。
对方一头那柔顺的黑发湿漉漉的贴在脸颊上，衣服也被浸湿了，一袭黑衣贴着那曼妙曲线。
看到这一幕，许元没感觉任何的旖旎，反而有些脑溢血。
他忽然理解《沧源》中许长天这位三公子为什么会有好几条线都是离奇的死在了被绑票的路上了。

这白痴女人，居然..居然把他这个被敲晕的病号趟着冬雨带到了这里，然后直接扔下不管。
这种冬夜阴雨，对于她当然不算什么，但对于一个普通人已经可以致命。
山洞内一片沉寂，淅沥沥的雨声轻飘飘的洞外渗入。
深深的吸了一口气，许元虚弱的出声：
“冉青墨.......”
原本温润如玉的声音已经变得沙哑至极。
洞口的女子闻言缓缓的睁开眸子，平淡朝他望来。
许元喘着气，虚弱的一字一顿；
“你...你想让我直接死在这么？”
冉青墨黑纱掩面，露|出的一双美眸微微眨了眨，摇头。
在许元性命这一问题上，她与许元的观点高度统一。
许元强忍着身体的不适：
“不想让我冻死，就..就帮我生一团火。”
冉青墨盯着许元看了两秒，美眸眨了很久，认真的回道：
“可是，火折子没了。”
许元张了张嘴，改口问道： “你的炁呢？”
这方世界所存在的 “炁”几乎可以说是万能的能源。
虽然《沧源》的游戏中没有表现这一点，但作为顶尖战力能将偌大的京城打成废墟的超凡世界，生个火这么简单事情怎么想都应该难不倒眼前这位大高手。
冉青墨美眸眨巴两下，从地面上爬起，缓缓走到许元面前，伸出了一只纤纤玉手放到许元面前。
许元眼中闪过一抹疑惑。

他便发现一阵气旋在她的手上悄然凝聚，转瞬一块直径十几厘米大冰坨子凝聚在
了她的手中。
手里拿冰坨，冉青墨似乎丝毫感受不到寒冷，眨巴着眼睛，往前许元面前递了递：
“冰，可以么？”
“........”
看着眼前递来的大冰坨，许元下意识觉得这女人再和他开玩笑。
但看见对方认真的眼神后，忍着脑溢血的冲动，许元深深的吸了一口气：
“我生病了，需要篝火，热水和食物。”
冉青墨盯着许元的面容看了两秒，似乎是在确认他的状态。
两秒后，
她默默走到洞穴角落放着的一个行囊前，一通翻找，找出一只水囊和一张干饼，走回许元面前，将二者递给了他。
许元看看手里的食物和水，又看看面前女人，已经被冻得发白额嘴唇微微颤抖：
“火呢？生火...我现在最需要的是热源和热水....”
“可是，火折子没有了。”
“........”许元。
眼前一阵发黑，许元被气得低笑两声，一股令人窒息的眩晕感般涌上心头。
病痛带来的困倦与眩晕，不断催促着让他沉沉睡去，但他知道这个时候睡了，多半就是一辈子。
连忙收敛心神，稳住意识，许元舔了舔发白的嘴唇，道：
“可以..可以帮我传功疗伤么？”
这方世界医疗体系很是古旧，但因为炁的存在，某种程度上并不比前世的差。

但在这种深山老林，明显是指望不上。
不过许元却记得在《沧源》的剧情中有过一段传功疗伤的老套剧情。
冉青墨闻言扔掉手中的冰坨，干脆利落的坐到了许元身前，没有顾及男女之别，直接把他衣服掀起，将一根纤长的玉指点他的小腹处。
感受着一股冰凉从小腹钻入，许元心中一喜。
但下一刻，
冰凉感瞬间消失，冉青墨忽然又把手给挪开了。
洞穴内大眼瞪小眼，
许元沙哑着声音：
“怎么了？”
冉青墨眨巴两下眼睛，低声说道：
“你没有炁，会死。”
许元低头看了一眼自己：
“为什么？”
“你没有炁。”
“.......”许元。
当游戏中一笔带过的设定化为现实，其中被略过的细节自然而然的便会被自动补全。
炁这种神奇的物质确实可以帮人疗伤。
但传功疗伤本质其实是借助他人的炁，对自己体内的炁进行引导，然后在被打通的经络中运转。
途经过的地方会被炁一点点的修补，有害的物质也会被炁给吞噬。
而普通人没有开始修行，经络就会一直闭塞。

许元的入口就这么点大，冉青墨的炁自然进不去，强行怼进去的结果就是裂开。
字面意义上的，
知晓了原理，山洞内一片寂静。
虚弱的靠在冰冷的石壁上，许元发现自己这具身体的状态出乎预料的差，想要将身上的湿衣脱去的力气都已经没有。
因为发烧、因为失温，他现在的意识已经开始迷糊，没有昏迷全靠他求生的意志力在苦撑着。
前世他去冰岛那边探险也失温过一次，但好在同行的人中有德爷那个级别的野外求生大佬陪着，才堪堪活了下来。
至于现在？
许元瞥了一眼身旁女子。
安静的坐在许元的身旁，黛眉微微皱起，似乎在苦恼怎么解决眼前的肉票要被病死的难题。
被一个什么都不懂的大冰坨子照顾，许元不认为自己睡着过后还能再醒过来。
脑海中一点点检索着在野外生火的方式，但一一都被他否决。
要么是没有工具，要么是材料不够，就连最基本的钻木取火在这种大雨之下也不可能找到合适的干柴与木屑。
沉默间，
时间就这么一分一秒的流逝。
许元眼前的视野逐渐暗淡，身体不受控制朝着一旁的地面倒去。
视野消失前的画面定格在了，黑衣女子起身走出洞穴的一幕。
她...要去哪？
最后思绪闪过，眼前陷入一片黑暗.......
content_en:
"Tsk...my head hurts...my body feels so cold..."
Accompanied by the bleak cold wind, Xu Yuan woke up from chaos again. An internal and external headache made Xu Yuan not want to open his eyes.
The clothes on his body were wet, and the biting cold wind blew on the wet clothes, constantly taking away the little heat from his body.
Almost instantly, Xu Yuan realized that his body had lost its temperature.
Opening his eyes little by little, Xu Yuan's memories before he fell into coma flooded into his mind.
Time travel, giant Buddha, and that sap from the woman in black.
After roughly figuring out his situation, Xu Yuan moved his eyes with some difficulty and began to take stock of his surroundings as he suffered from internal and external headaches.
This seems to be a cave, not big, only four or five meters deep.
It was already dawn outside the cave, and the rain was still pouring down, but this time there was no bonfire in the Buddhist hall, and the cave was a little cold.
The woman in black was sitting at the door of the cave with her eyes closed and meditating. Her sword was lying flat beside her, and there was a rather familiar wooden stick beside the sword blade.
"..." Xu Yuan.
Pursing his dry and white lips, Xu Yuan moved his body little by little and leaned against the cold stone wall behind him.
Just this simple movement of tightening made his frail body start to pant.
In his previous life, his relatively good family background gave him enough time and money to experience a variety of different lives, one of which was wilderness adventure travel.
And it is precisely because of this that past experiences made Xu Yuan know that he was seriously ill now.
Hypothermia, high fever, and even some dehydration.
Xu Yuan looked at the woman in black wearing a gauze mask at the entrance of the cave.
The other person's smooth black hair was wet and stuck to his cheeks, and his clothes were soaked. He was dressed in black and clung to his graceful curves.
Seeing this scene, Xu Yuan didn't feel any charm, but felt a little cerebral hemorrhage.
He suddenly understood why Xu Changtian, the third young master in "Cang Yuan", had several lines where he mysteriously died on the way to being kidnapped.
This idiot woman actually... actually brought him, a knocked-out patient, here through the winter rain, and then left him alone.
This kind of rainy winter night was nothing to her, but it could be fatal to an ordinary person.
There was silence in the cave, and the sound of pattering rain filtered in lightly from outside the cave.
Taking a deep breath, Xu Yuan said weakly:
"Ran Qingmo..."
The voice that was originally as gentle as jade has become extremely hoarse.
The woman at the entrance of the cave slowly opened her eyes and looked at him calmly.
Xu Yuan gasped and spoke weakly;
"You...you want me to die like this?"
Ran Qingmo covered her face with black gauze, revealing a pair of beautiful eyes and blinked slightly, shaking her head.
On the issue of Xu Yuan's life, she and Xu Yuan have highly unified views.
Xu Yuan endured his physical discomfort:
"If you don't want me to freeze to death, just...just help me light a fire."
Ran Qingmo stared at Xu Yuan for two seconds, blinked her beautiful eyes for a long time, and replied seriously:
"But the fire is gone."
Xu Yuan opened his mouth, changed his words and asked, "Where is your Qi?"
The "Qi" that exists in this world can be said to be almost a universal energy source.
Although this is not shown in the game "Cangyuan", as a world with top-notch combat power that can reduce a huge capital city to rubble, something as simple as lighting a fire should not be difficult for the great master in front of him.
Ran Qingmo blinked twice, climbed up from the ground, walked slowly to Xu Yuan, stretched out a delicate hand and placed it in front of Xu Yuan.
A flash of doubt flashed in Xu Yuan's eyes.
He then noticed a whirlpool quietly condensing on her hand, and in an instant, a large lump of ice with a diameter of more than ten centimeters condensed on her hand.
into her hands.
Holding the ice cube in his hand, Ran Qingmo seemed not to feel the cold at all, blinking his eyes,He went forward and handed it to Xu Yuan:
"Ice, is that okay?"
"..."
Looking at the big lump of ice handed to him, Xu Yuan subconsciously felt that this woman was joking with him again.
But after seeing the serious look in his eyes, Xu Yuan took a deep breath, resisting the urge to have a cerebral hemorrhage:
"I'm sick and need a campfire, hot water and food."
Ran Qingmo stared at Xu Yuan's face for two seconds, seeming to confirm his status.
Two seconds later,
She silently walked to a luggage placed in the corner of the cave, rummaged through it, found a water bag and a piece of dry biscuit, walked back to Xu Yuan, and handed them both to him.
Xu Yuan looked at the food and water in his hands, and then at the woman in front of him. His forehead was white with the cold, and his lips were trembling slightly:
"Where's the fire? Make a fire... What I need most now is a heat source and hot water..."
"But there is no more Huozhezi."
"..." Xu Yuan.
His vision turned black for a while, Xu Yuan was so angry that he chuckled twice, and a suffocating dizziness came to his heart.
The sleepiness and dizziness caused by the illness kept urging him to fall asleep, but he knew that if he slept at this time, he would probably sleep for the rest of his life.
Quickly gathering his mind and stabilizing his consciousness, Xu Yuan licked his white lips and said:
"Can...can you help me teach you the exercises to heal my injuries?"
The medical system in this world is very old, but because of the existence of Qi, it is no worse than the one in the previous life to some extent.
But in such deep mountains and old forests, it is obviously impossible to count on it.
However, Xu Yuan remembered that in the plot of "Cang Yuan", there was a clichéd plot about teaching martial arts and healing injuries.
Upon hearing this, Ran Qingmo threw away the ice lump in his hand and sat down neatly in front of Xu Yuan. Without taking into account the difference between men and women, he directly lifted up his clothes and pointed a slender jade finger at his lower abdomen.
Feeling a cold feeling penetrate into his lower abdomen, Xu Yuan felt happy.
But the next moment,
The cold feeling disappeared instantly, and Ran Qingmo suddenly moved his hand away again.
Big eyes stare at small eyes in the cave,
Xu Yuan said in a hoarse voice:
"What's wrong?"
Ran Qingmo blinked twice and whispered:
"If you don't have Qi, you will die."
Xu Yuan lowered his head and glanced at himself:
"Why?"
"You don't have Qi."
"..." Xu Yuan.
When the settings that were briefly mentioned in the game become reality, the skipped details will naturally be automatically completed.
Qi, a magical substance, can indeed help people heal.
However, the essence of Qigong healing is actually to use the Qi of others to guide the Qi in one's own body, and then circulate it in the opened meridians.
The places it passes through will be repaired bit by bit by Qi, and harmful substances will also be swallowed up by Qi.
But if ordinary people don't start practicing, their meridians will remain blocked.
Xu Yuan's entrance was only so big, so Ran Qingmo's Qi naturally couldn't get in. The result of forcing it in would be splitting.
Literally,
Knowing the principle, there was silence in the cave.
Leaning weakly against the cold stone wall, Xu Yuan found that the condition of his body was unexpectedly worse than expected, and he no longer had the strength to take off the wet clothes on his body.
Because of fever and hypothermia, his consciousness has begun to become confused. He is not comatose because of his willpower to survive.
In his previous life, he experienced hypothermia once when he was exploring in Iceland, but fortunately, he was accompanied by a wild survival expert of Master De's level, so he managed to survive.
As for now?
Xu Yuan glanced at the woman beside him.
Sitting quietly next to Xu Yuan, her eyebrows furrowed slightly, as if she was worried about how to solve the problem of the meat ticket in front of her that was about to die of illness.
Being taken care of by a big Bingtuozi who didn't understand anything, Xu Yuan didn't think he could wake up again after falling asleep.
He searched for ways to make a fire in the wild bit by bit in his mind, but he rejected them all.
Either there are no tools or there are not enough materials. Even the most basic method of drilling wood to make fire is difficult under such heavy rain.It is impossible to find suitable dry firewood and sawdust.
in silence,
Time passes like this minute by minute.
Xu Yuan's vision gradually dimmed, and his body fell uncontrollably towards the ground aside.
The scene before the vision disappeared was fixed on the scene of the woman in black getting up and walking out of the cave.
Where is she going?
Finally, thoughts flashed through, and my eyes fell into darkness...
